d:
Ready for the Garba Night? This Navratri Season, Presenting "Dholida (GARBA-MIX)" from the film Loveyatri. Sung by Udit Narayan, Neha Kakkar, Palak Muchhal & Raja Hassan, composed by Tanishk Bagchi, written by Shabbir Ahmed & remixed by Dj Star & Dj Ishitaa.
Credits:
Song- Dholida
Singer- Udit Narayan, Neha Kakkar, Palak Muchchal, Raja Hassan
Music -Tanishk Bagchi
Lyrics - Shabbir Ahmed
Remixed By - Dj Star, Dj Ishitaa
Music Supervisor - Azeem Dayani
